# Arrival save fixture

`arrival-v2.sav` is a 131,088-byte Flash1M save written through the Cormoria ROM's in-game Save menu and cold-reloaded by libmGBA. Its selected save slot resumes in Carabrue Town Home 1F (map 79:1, warp 255); SHA-256 is `b6493f464b5d114090ad9c6672be94ff852582f49ee3adaef1c4a09760ebc2ed`.

The fixture carries identity registry version 2 and remains a historical save sample.

`arrival-v3-cormoria-carabrue.sav` is a 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M save written through the current Cormoria ROM's in-game Save menu and cold-reloaded by pinned mGBA 0.11. It was seeded from a synthetic registry-v3 adaptation of the older fixture, then overwritten by the ROM; it is not a fresh-new-game save. The source ROM is the clean two-world build at `f59cc59416`, Cormoria ROM SHA-256 `11c510cec9e03ce84a713aa982eea70da08619d30dd7da5c199cff4836a9326c`. The save SHA-256 is `c17f39cd98342281ab0de668a6b9daa83f264f058ac642a55d5b5543f90e6765`. `verify_arrival_save` accepts registry v3, map 79:1, warp 255 and layout 1194. Catalog contract tests use this immutable image instead of modifying a save's registry bytes in Python.

`arrival-v3-cormoria-rivetshore.sav` is a 131,088-byte registry-v3 Flash1M image derived from a clean new Cormoria character. The character completed the Carabrue home introduction, and the ROM saved it in-game (SHA-256 `92229f2bb0c384b83878841dd067cc69211afd92ee4dac696ad774cd27bfd8d7`). A first scratch save moved the selected slot to Rivetshore Harbor and was saved again by the ROM (SHA-256 `89b8fd74cbdd0505cc17fc0b4d213e3c90a4384c0690108f87c0929bb9887369`), but its cached map view and objects remained from the previous map. A second scratch copy set the existing `CONTINUE_GAME_WARP` flag and copied the harbor position (map 82:21, warp 255, x=8, y=14) to `continueGameWarp`, then recalculated the two affected sector checksums (staged SHA-256 `77c894b281f958aa4bf809f9a67097da7fceb4964fd65326fa524c2183c7bd7c`). The exact Cormoria ROM from hosted run `36279286826` booted this copy through its own map-warp path, rendered the full Rivetshore Harbor and attendant, and wrote a new generation-3 save through its in-game Save menu. Pinned mGBA cold-Continued that final image into the same coherent harbor; its bytes remained unchanged. Final SHA-256: `37556fab38650c8de3793ca521ce635eb31c9d6c30268ac53b96088596846157`. The strict verifier accepts registry v3, map 82:21, warp 255 and layout 1314.

`arrival-v3-main-lilycove.sav` is the corresponding 131,088-byte image from a clean new Main character. The character left the moving truck, entered the Littleroot home and saved in-game (SHA-256 `90e3c8629e79b1dcf4425c58eb80a0b83d02fd007a94f4b15fa46a261c809c8a`). An earlier scratch save moved the selected slot to Lilycove Harbor and was saved again by the ROM, but cached map view and objects still belonged to Littleroot. After subsequent exact-ROM recertification and local server save lineage advanced the selected slot to generation 4, a scratch copy set the existing `CONTINUE_GAME_WARP` flag and harbor warp (map 13:10, warp 255, x=8, y=11) and recalculated affected sector checksums (staged SHA-256 `9d35144e8f78f317ed9364b58ac8af6e19f7f1dd0871ef5419eef08d6848a386`). The exact Main ROM from hosted run `36279286826` booted through its own map-warp path, rendered the full Lilycove Harbor with the correct Beauty attendant, and saved normally. Pinned mGBA 0.11 cold-Continued the coherent generation-5 image without changing its bytes. Final SHA-256: `4adf3c40c6133ee8e5c2226304321d936da1ee9285662eef4437ef435de04e0e`. The strict verifier accepts registry v3, map 13:10, warp 255 and layout 88.

The Carabrue image remains a contract fixture. The Rivetshore and Lilycove images are first-arrival candidates; final release validation still needs the exact release ROMs, map-to-layout bindings against those ROMs and a live cross-ROM player-data roundtrip.
